about.title: About LLMCompare
about.backgroundDesc: Maintained by AI enthusiasts, curating public data on Chinese LLMs — all from public sources. Data is continuously tracked for new model versions and pricing changes (last updated: 2026.05.04).
about.backgroundContribute: Spot an error or want to add a model? Submit an issue on
about.filterDesc: From Artificial Analysis' global index, we filter Chinese vendors' large-scale models, enrich with vendor links and OpenRouter data, retaining models active within 180 days.
about.sourceDesc: Artificial Analysis is an authoritative LLM evaluation org providing standardized benchmarks. Its Intelligence Index combines MMLU, HumanEval, MATH, and other benchmarks to assess reasoning, coding, and math capabilities.
about.priceDetail: Official pricing sourced from model vendor websites and shown on detail pages, alongside Artificial Analysis and OpenRouter pricing. The table uses OpenRouter pricing for consistent comparison. Updated weekly.
about.sftDesc: A leading AI cloud service platform in China, providing model inference, fine-tuning, and deployment services. We collect their public domestic model pricing data as a complement to OpenRouter's international pricing, helping users understand the real price level in the domestic market.
about.orDesc: The world's largest LLM API routing platform, providing unified API access and weekly token consumption rankings. We collect its public weekly rankings and API pricing — volume reflects real-world usage, pricing reflects market rates.
about.disclaimerDesc: This field guide is for reference only. Model performance varies by use case and may differ from the data presented.
